Lane h-client (M12-phase-h:H-L2-client). Commits on track/h-client, not landed, not pushed:
- 221d62a feat(invested-funds): GET /v1/client/invested-funds and /{fundId} (contract client-invested-funds.ts); optional fundId on /v1/client/receipts and /v1/client/value-updates.
- 3784dd6 fix(client-ui): legal and grievance screens render the published content shape; Support and Login show published contacts.

- 08fe83c fix(client-ui): Your investment screen (/portfolio/funds/:fundId), fund names with error+retry, failed eligibility/SIP reads, admin SIP schedules on Dashboard, app-update Open, value-update highlight notice.
No migration (071 not taken). No released response shape changed: new endpoints and optional query params only.
Defaults a reviewer should examine:
- Endpoint named invested-funds, not holdings: investment-architecture.guard bans the word holdings in backend source; the first backend check failed on it.
- Invested fund = any fund with a client_value_entries row for the user; name = current published version name else slug (as value updates); fundPublished = state published and a published version.
- Routes register in recordingComposition.ts (composition.ts untouched). Cursor filter hash includes fundId only when sent, so existing cursors stay valid.
- Support contact = investor-charter document's contact block (Legal says the charter names who to contact). Grievance shows its own summary, steps, timelines and contacts.

- Readers accept both shapes: contacts[] (label/value) and contact{} (officerName, email, phone, hours, address); sections with body or items; steps with title/description/timeline/contactEmail. mailto/tel links only for values shaped like an email or phone; anything else is plain text.
- Login help is client-only, supplied by the client shell via AuthPort.loginHelp (admin passes null). Generic login refusal unchanged; unpublished content gives neutral copy with no address.
- Portfolio, Activity ledger and Value updates link to Your investment; Fund details only while published; closed funds get an info note.
- Activity payment tab and OnlinePaymentHistory still name funds from the catalogue (Fund on failure): payment surfaces parked (finding-27).

- Gateway SIP row and Manage SIPs (Dashboard) and the SIP plans button (Portfolio) show only with gateway plans or after a failed SIP read; admin schedules via SipSchedulesSection on Dashboard (already on Portfolio). SIP screens untouched.
- App-update notice: Open shows only when the update feed offers an optional update (UpdatePrompt context in AppUpdateGate); it marks the notice read and reopens the sheet.
- Email verification rows show Couldn't check + Try again on a failed eligibility read (InlineReadFailure, shared with InvestingStatus).
- Value updates: notified entry on an older page gives a Show older updates notice; not found after all pages says it may have been corrected.

Evidence (tally): mutation dropping the user scope in findByUser fails the new 404 test; frontend check 35 files/320 tests on 3784dd6 alone; admin cross-target dist check passes. Full rule-52 sweep on clean 08fe83c: contracts 98 tests; backend check 101 files/1204; integration 65 files/558; frontend check 35/320; build:client (17 assets, 932,428 bytes) and build:admin pass. Start times on non-sweep records are approximate.
Not verified: no browser or device run (no dev server started); real published content in production unknown.

Risk for the maintainer (possible Q): the content seed's contacts are placeholders (support@beonedge.example, grievance@beonedge.example, +91-80-1234-5678/5679). Production runs only seed:auth, so the legal rows may be absent (screens fall back) or hold placeholders, which now render. No admin editor exists for these documents.
An earlier draft leaked client screens into the admin bundle through CLIENT_ROUTES; fixed (contacts resolve without the route manifest) and checked with check-android-dist --variant=admin.
